units.rawText: When we met in the Enigma Sector, I saw you as a Daemon and viewed you and all the Oasis as enemies.
units.displayText: When we met in the Enigma Sector, I saw you as a Daemon and viewed you and all the Oasis as enemies.

spans.text: When we met in the Enigma Sector, I saw you as a Daemon and viewed you and all the Oasis as enemies.

units.rawText: After being beaten, I ought to have martyred myself for my faith, but you did not strike the killing blow. Instead, you let me leave. I could not understand why you did that... At least, at the time.

spans.text: After being beaten, I ought to have martyred myself for my faith, but you did not strike the killing blow. Instead, you let me leave. I could not understand why you did that... At least, at the time.

units.rawText: Once, doubt and confusion plagued my bow, but after experiencing many things, I learned to contemplate and I have judged the Sanctifiers and the Oasis anew.
units.displayText: Once, doubt and confusion plagued my bow, but after experiencing many things, I learned to contemplate and I have judged the Sanctifiers and the Oasis anew.

spans.text: Once, doubt and confusion plagued my bow, but after experiencing many things, I learned to contemplate and I have judged the Sanctifiers and the Oasis anew.

units.rawText: As for the relationship between you and I, I am still working hard to figure it out and find the answer. Until I do, will you allow me to stay by your side? This is a request from both the Sanctifiers and from me.
